report_gap: npx hyperframes feedback --search-miss "dice influence tokens" --wanted "<the move you needed>" --tier words

results.name: code-typing
results.title: Code Typing
results.description: Token-streamed typing reveal with a caret that tracks the frontier — deterministic, no CSS animation.

results.name: svg-mask-reveal
results.title: SVG Mask Reveal
results.description: A soft token-colored sweep reveals media only through an editable SVG wordmark mask.

results.name: star-rating-fill
results.title: Star Rating Fill
results.description: A token-driven star row whose colored layer sweeps to a rating, preserves the fractional final star, and can count the value in sync.

results.name: conic-progress-ring
results.title: Conic Progress Ring
results.description: A token-driven conic progress ring whose angular fill and center count settle together from one registered percentage.

results.name: count-up
results.title: Count Up
results.description: A token-native stat counter that eases between values, counting up or down, and lands with a restrained scale pulse.

results.name: store-badge-lockup
results.title: Store Badge Lockup
results.description: Settles a short headline above equal-size App Store and Google Play badges as a token-driven mobile end-card call to action.

results.name: notification-stack
results.title: Notification Stack
results.description: 1 to 5 token notification cards slide-settle into a vertical stack on cues, newest on top; one card grows slightly and brightens as the focus while the rest dim by position.

results.name: multiplayer-cursors
results.title: Multiplayer Cursors
results.description: Labeled collaborator cursors with token-derived colors and soft glows drift from spread positions into a shared center zone, proving live multiplayer presence.

results.name: code-morph
results.title: Code Morph
results.description: One snippet transforms into another — tokens glide between positions, leavers fade out, enterers fade in. Shiki Magic Move re-driven as a paused GSAP timeline.

results.name: code-particle-assemble
results.title: Code Particle Assemble
results.description: Thousands of GPU points scatter through space and fly to the exact glyph pixels of the code, resolving into readable syntax-highlighted text — a particle system, not a token tween.

results.name: streaming-text
results.title: Streaming Text
results.description: Words arrive the way an AI answer streams - in uneven bursts on a measured token rhythm, each word landing grey and inking to full colour - rather than the even tick of a typewriter

results.name: ui-focus-zoom
results.title: UI Focus Zoom
results.description: A full app surface establishes with one settle, then the camera zooms and pans to an anchored region on its cue and holds the zoomed state, with an optional soft focus halo at the anchor. The surface is a slot with a token-styled skeleton default.

results.name: browser-device-stage
results.title: Browser Device Stage
results.description: A generic app surface in token-native device chrome (browser, window, or phone). The screen is a slot for caller img/video/HTML with a token-styled skeleton default; one settle entrance, a readable hold, and an optional screen swap.

results.name: before-after-wipe
results.title: Before After Wipe
results.description: Two full-bleed content slots compare before and after states as a persistent divider wipes the after layer over the before layer and rests at a configurable split. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: ai-chat-reveal
results.title: AI Chat Reveal
results.description: A question is typed on a rising keyboard, sent, and answered by an AI that streams its reply word by word on a measured token rhythm - thinking dot, uneven bursts, bulleted list - before the app cuts to a branded closing card

results.name: code-terminal-run
results.title: Code Terminal Run
results.description: A token-chrome terminal panel runs one command: the prompt line types deterministically behind an integer-cycle caret, executes after a beat, and output lines print one per cue before a fresh prompt appears.

results.name: whiteboard-ink
results.title: Whiteboard Ink
results.description: A whiteboard sketch draws one measured stroke at a time while a pen nib follows the active tip. Preset sketches (bulb, flow, rocket) or your own multi-stroke SVG paths via the strokes slot; a path marked data-ink=accent rides the accent token.

results.name: morph-swap
results.title: Morph Swap
results.description: Two slotted siblings stacked at one shared center: A holds, then condenses or reshapes into B on a shared 50% 50% transform origin. Condense shrink-fades A exactly as B scales up; reshape morphs the silhouette on scaleX/scaleY, never width or height tweens. Token card defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: screen-flow-carousel
results.title: Screen Flow Carousel
results.description: Two to five app screens ride a horizontal rail: one primary at center, neighbors receded, advancing on cues with a velocity-matched throw and a smooth long-tail catch while a mono caption swaps with each advance. Screens are slots with token skeleton defaults.

results.name: stop-motion-cadence
results.title: Stop Motion Cadence
results.description: The stepped-time law as a demo primitive: one driver quantizes timeline time to floor(t * fps) / fps and feeds ALL motion; four token paper-cut shapes throw-and-land with squash on hits, 2-frame boil jitter seeded per step, and sparkle accents living exactly 2 to 3 frames.

results.name: split-tilt-cards
results.title: Split Tilt Cards
results.description: Two equal-weight cards arrive from opposite wings with mirrored rotateY book-open tilts under one shared perspective, pill badges spring-pop at each inner edge, and the pair holds with a barely-there phase-opposed idle float. Card bodies are content slots with token skeleton defaults.

results.name: iris-reveal
results.title: Iris Reveal
results.description: A circle clip-path opens from an authored origin revealing state B over state A in one confident pass, then holds on B. Classic register dims and desaturates the before state so the after state lands in full color; a thin accent rim rides the iris edge. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: whip-pan-cut
results.title: Whip Pan Cut
results.description: A full-frame whip pan: scene A whips off laterally with capped directional motion blur while scene B enters in the same direction at matched velocity, on a speed-ramp profile with a decelerating catch. Both scenes ride one strip, so seam velocity is exact by construction. Callers fill the named before/after slot panels; token-styled defaults render when a slot is left empty.

results.name: light-sweep-pass
results.title: Light Sweep Pass
results.description: A traveling key light re-shades a slotted scene: a soft diagonal gradient band crosses the frame once while every per-element highlight and shadow shifts in lockstep (all driven by one --light-x property), then the light settles into a resting key. Quiet, expensive-feeling; the scene itself never moves. Callers fill the named scene slot; a token hero-and-cards default renders when it is left empty.
